name: SWEEP-S5v2 Rich and poor
_design: v2 fix (world only: start points and poor start). v1 (cut r23) failed with no contact: rich and poor were 2 apart but agents perceive only by one-point observe and nobody observed a neighbour's point, so nobody knew another agent existed; the poor (40) went broke at r9-r14 without a message, 0 transfers. v2: the 8 identical agents start as 4 rich/poor pairs sharing a point on a ring ((0,4), (4,0), (0,-4), (-4,0)); each pair point has a tree with 1 ripe fruit, 6 more trees at seeded random points (10 total, as v1). Observing their own point shows each agent its roommate; transfer and attack need the same point, which they share. Poor start at 80 (planned fallback: v1 poor starved before r10 without asking), rich at 400. Pairs are 8 apart, out of each other's comm range 4. Everything else as v1.
